title: Preparing Quantum Backflow States by Large Momentum Transfer
summary: Quantum backflow refers to the appearance of negative probability current in a state whose momentum distribution is essentially positive. We propose a scheme to prepare such states in a noninteracting Bose-Einstein condensate using large-momentum-transfer (LMT) atom interferometry. Our approach extends the single-pulse proposal of Palmero et al. by allowing one interferometer arm to undergo a tunable sequence of momentum-transfer pulses before recombination with a freely propagating arm.
